text: The Board of Health will introduce and enact: Bill 1 - To Repeal By-law 2-2016 Governing the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit. Bill 2 - To Govern the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit.

The Board of Health introduced and enacted the following: 1. Bill 1 - To Repeal By-law 2-2016 Governing the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit; and 2. Bill 2 - To Govern the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit.
